title: High-demand stockout risk
situation: A distribution center may run out of a high-demand product within five days.

title: Primary supplier disruption
situation: The primary supplier has suspended shipments while a distribution center has limited coverage.

title: Procurement cost spike
situation: Market prices have risen sharply and the buyer must protect budget without creating avoidable continuity risk.

title: Supplier quality alert
situation: A quality alert raises the chance that incoming components will fail inspection.

title: Seasonal demand surge
situation: Forecast demand is rising ahead of a seasonal peak and replenishment capacity may become constrained.

title: Transport strike
situation: Industrial action threatens the usual freight corridor and alternative routes have different cost and service profiles.
decision_conflict: Cheap transport versus fast reliable routing

title: Perishable goods
situation: Temperature-sensitive goods need replenishment and a cold-chain excursion could make the shipment unusable.

title: Single-source dependency
situation: A critical item is sourced from one supplier and leadership is considering a diversified replenishment strategy.
